Area × voter density = electorate.
Volume shows eligible voters.
The footprint is geographic area; height adds the density of eligible voters, including non-voters. Heights start at zero and are neither capped nor log-scaled. Colour identifies the party with the most valid second votes, not necessarily a majority or the winner of the constituency seat. All other parties’ votes remain part of the result.
Results: Landeswahlleiter NRW / IT.NRW, final second votes, 15 May 2022. Boundaries: © Stadt Lünen, CC BY 4.0; © Ministerium des Innern NRW / IT.NRW, Wahlkreiseinteilung 2022.
Height uses eligible voters and unsimplified polygon areas in equal-area projection EPSG:3035. Shared display boundaries were repaired and simplified; maximum footprint-area change: 0.05%.
